entry.title: The Need to Heal | Batman x DCU x The Walking Dead
entry.summary:
Author: Pick_up_your_Pen

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 13,815Chapters: 1/?Kudos: 2

Summary: Nine years had passed since the outbreak started and the dead started walking. Nine years had passed since civilization has fell. It certainly hasn't been an easy road for eighteen-year-old Jacob Wayne, being put in foster care before the outbreak, having to raise his baby sister on his own, losing loved ones left and right, and being trained by mercenary assassins to help increase his survival. When he finally finds a home to settle down in for him and his sister, he ends up meeting his long lost childhood best-friend named Clementine who is protecting her family, and he befriends a guy named Jason Todd who has a never-ending grudge against a man who failed to be his father many years ago. And what if that same man turns out to be Jacob's biological father he's never met before? The said biological father, Bruce Wayne, is far away in a lab in The Watch-Tower, doing everything he can to create a cure to stop the outbreak. But after spending nine years on this cure, after failing to save so many, after neglecting and pushing away the Bat-Family that is broken and the Justice League that is divided, he's not sure if anything is possible anymore. Author: Smarty2604

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 25,356Chapters: 3/30Kudos: 40

Summary: Dick shows up with twins and a letter that changes everything. Jason comes home with a daughter and a heartbreak he can't fix, no matter how hard he tried. Damian returns without warning, carrying two sons—more responsibility than he’s ever known, and the certainty that he has no room left for pride. And Tim—Tim's world has shattered in a way that he doesn't know if he'll come back from. But he has to. For his son. Two weeks doesn’t sound like long—until you’re raising a baby alone. One by one, the Robins come home carrying infants, exhaustion, and a grief that refuses to wait for you to be ready. The kind that doesn't care how strong you are. What they find isn’t a mission or a mantle—but a family learning how to stand still long enough to heal. Bruce Wayne expects a productive day at the Batcomputer.Instead, he gets his sons back in a single heartbreaking evening. This is where the legacy begins.This is why the Robins came home.
